name: Needle
description: Artful thrusts, pirouettes, and deadly footwork. Puncturing, weaving, and sewing through all manner of foe and beast.

abilities.name: Swift Strikes
abilities.description: The Needlesbug may attack using Grace, rather than Might, to hit with melee weapons, but not with weapons of 2 Bulk or greater. Needle-type weapons are an exception.

abilities.name: Sharp Lunge
abilities.description: The Needlesbug may accept a -1 die penalty on their attack roll to increase the range of the attack by 1. Treated as a free dash.

abilities.name: Battle Dance
abilities.description: When dashing, jumping, or moving while dodging, gain 1 Momentum. Momentum can be dedicated as additional Stamina for attacks/dodges. Max Momentum equal to Needle Rank.

abilities.name: Untouchable
abilities.description: 6s on dodge attempts count as two successes. When moving after dodging, they do not suffer Off-Balance.
